LESSON: READING 13.2.1 EXTENSIVE READING

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 13
Topic 13.2: Reading 13.2.1 Extensive Reading
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 13.2.1 Extensive Reading, part of Strand 13 in Grade 6 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

Key inquiry question: Why do we enjoy reading some materials but not others? 2. How do you obtain information from a newspaper, book, or magazine quickly?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. skim various texts to find out the general idea,

2. scan a text to find specific details such as key words,

3. read a variety of texts of about 1251 to 1500 words from newspaper, magazines, grade- appropriate digital/print texts, as well as articles,

4. collaborate with peers to establish a class library,

5. read print and non-print materials (websites and blogs) independently,

6. read newspapers, magazines poems, and class readers on trade,

7. read digital versions of newspapers and magazines for information. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. skim various texts to find out the general idea,
2. scan a text to find specific details such as key words,
3. read a variety of texts of about 1251 to 1500 words from newspaper, magazines, grade- appropriate digital/print texts, as well as articles,
4. collaborate with peers to establish a class library,
5. read print and non-print materials (websites and blogs) independently,
6. read newspapers, magazines poems, and class readers on trade,
7. read digital versions of newspapers and magazines for information. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 13.2.1 Extensive Reading together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Self-efficacy: The learner’s ability to confidently express themselves is boosted as they practise reading

increasingly difficult texts.

• Digital Literacy: The learner’s ability to manipulate digital devices is improved as they read online versions of

newspapers.

Values

Respect: It is fostered as the learner appreciates diverse opinions and collaborate with peers to establish a class

library.
